notes.title: Release Preview 2.0.1
notes.content:
Hello, everyone, 

We are working hard to give you the best possible experience in Improbable Soccer.
This update fixes a couple of issues found in the last update.

Here is the changelog:
[list]
[*] Added new songs to menu playlist by [url=https://www.youtube.com/nocopyrightsounds]NoCopyrightSounds[/url]
[*] Fixed the problem related to audio settings at the beginning of the game
[*] Fixed several issues related to achievements that were not being unlocked correctly
[*] Fixed some translations related to the music player 
[*] Fixed an issue that did not allow reselecting buttons in the menu when opening a bug report
[/list]

We look forward to seeing you on [url=https://discord.gg/XPwXd9qmY4]our discord[/url] server to exchange opinions and feedback on this new version of the game.


Thank you all as always for your support!

- CyberLab Studios

notes.title: Improbable Soccer 2.0 Release Preview
notes.content:
Hello [b]Improbable players[/b]!

We are ready to show you the work we made in the last few years to give you the full release that this game deserves.

This is a preview build and is feature complete. There are still some details (especially sound) missing that we will work on in this final period before the final release.  

We want to thank all the people who volunteered to test the game and report bugs during the playtest phase that we launched in June 2024.

[h3]Here's the changelog:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Reprogrammed the entire game to improve the user experience and fix all the bugs that the first version of the game had.
[*] Redesigned the entire user interface to improve the use of the game especially from controller.
[*] Menus are now fully navigable from controller and keyboard (mouse no longer required)
[*] 4 new soccer stadiums: Sector GN0P, Oasi Stadium, Domus Aurea, Artic Wind Stadium
[*] Player customization in the lobby before the start of the game
[*] 27 new achievements
[*] AI improvements
[*] WIP translations of the game in [b]12 different languages[/b]: Italian, French, German, Spanish, Portoguese, Portoguese (Brasil), Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Turkish, Polish, Russian
[/list]

We look forward to seeing you on [url=https://discord.gg/XPwXd9qmY4]our discord server[/url] to exchange opinions and feedback on this new version of the game.


Thank you all for your support over the years. 
We hope you enjoy the work we have done. 

See you on the Improbable fields!

- CyberLab Studios

notes.title: Join the Improbable Soccer v2.0 Beta
notes.content:
Greetings, [b]Soccer Enthusiasts[/b]!

We’re thrilled to extend our heartfelt gratitude for your unwavering support of Improbable Soccer. Your passion fuels our journey to create an unparalleled gaming experience.

After an extensive period of dedication and meticulous enhancements, we’re excited to unveil the [b]Playtest of the full version[/b] of Improbable Soccer. This is your exclusive invitation to be part of this groundbreaking phase!

To join the adventure, simply visit our store page and select the “[b]Request Access[/b]” button.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37974511/619ef2fed1a2a8d07ba063d891e180f9ad450b8b.png[/img]

After that you’ll find it waiting in your library.

Your insights and feedbacks are invaluable during this beta phase. We encourage you to share your feedback or report any bugs on [url=https://discord.gg/XPwXd9qmY4]our Discord Server[/url]. Your contributions are essential in shaping the future of Improbable Soccer.

We can’t wait for you to experience the fruits of our labor!

A heartfelt thank you to all who assist us in testing.

[h2]Changelog: [/h2]
[list]
[*] New fields: Sector GN0P, Oasi Stadium, Domus Aurea, Artic Wind Stadium
[*] Completely re-designed user experience and user interface
[*] Menus are now fully navigable only with gamepad and keyboard
[*] Character customization
[*] New achievements
[*] AI improvements
[*] UI translation in a lot of different languages: Italian, French, German, Spanish, Portoguese, Portoguese (Brasil), Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Turkish, Polish, Russian (Still WIP, share your feedbacks about)
[*] A lot of bugfix
[/list]

notes.title: Improbable Soccer SEA 0.1.1 is now LIVE!
notes.content:
After a few months of work, we are ready to present the new new game: "Improbable Soccer". The one released today is the first of a long list of updates that will be made with community support through our [url=https://discord.com/invite/KHwMvNg]Discord server[/url]

In this first release are present:
- 4 different stages
- Training mode
- Games up to 6 players
- Artificial intelligence trained with machine learning

Thanks in advance to everyone!

Enjoy the game,
see you on the field.
